channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tony Bradley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tony Bradley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tony Bradley
item.description:
Bradley only had played 17 minutes of mop-up duty in four appearances in the postseason, but he banged bodies a few times and grabbed a couple of rebounds with a positive rating of plus-1 in eight minutes — four each in the second and third quarters — in the Pacers’ 114-109 victory in Game 2 at…

“Tony Bradley hasn’t played in the series, but he’s one of our better rebounders,”

Rick Carlisle on Tony Bradley, May 24, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Desmond Bane on Steven Adams, Tony Bradley
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Desmond Bane on his viewpoint of Steven Adams carrying Tony Bradley:

“When I looked up on the Jumbotron and saw his feet hovering the ground and (Steven) carrying him like he a lil kid, I couldn’t help but laugh.”

Desmond Bane on Steven Adams, Tony Bradley, Jan 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Georges Niang, Tony Bradley
item.description:
“I was really excited about the chemistry that we were getting with our second unit that Quin had found with Mike Conley, Jordan Clarkson, Joe Ingles, Georges Niang and Tony Bradley,”

Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Georges Niang, Tony Bradley, May 8, 2020. Source: deseret.com.
